1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is light-activated and responsive to a specific wavelength of light for activation and reading.

2. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards through the bottom wall.

4. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer and is light-activated.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and one or more of the following: a rack for biorepository test tubes configured for automated handling; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes and reading the light-activated MTPs; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes and trigger reading of the light-activated MTPs.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 adapted for low temperature operation, wherein the light-activated MTPs remain readable and the racks/test tubes are handled at -20°C or less.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising embedding a light-activated MTP in plastic by heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded light-activated MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: providing an embedded light-activated MTP; and reading the MTP by directing light of a specific wavelength to activate and read the MTP.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in polypropylene or acetal polymer and is light-activated.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the test tube.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, oriented for reading downwards through the bottom wall.
